name: Xperience by Kentico
description_en:
Xperience by Kentico is the current Kentico content and digital experience platform, combining reusable content, website/email/headless channels and marketing tools. It offers Kentico-managed SaaS or customer-operated private cloud/on-premises deployment. The assigned Kentico CMS slug is retained, but current capabilities must not be read as a guarantee for every older Kentico Xperience installation.

The main buying units are channels, license tier, AI capacity and cloud resources. Managed infrastructure does not mean the vendor develops, deploys or patches the customer’s application project. The detailed SaaS documentation explicitly leaves those project duties with the implementation team.
description_zh:
Xperience by Kentico是当前Kentico内容及数字体验平台，结合复用内容、网站/邮件/无头渠道和营销工具，可选Kentico托管SaaS或客户自行运营私有云/本地部署。本记录保留原Kentico CMS slug，但不能将当前能力视为每个旧Kentico Xperience安装的保证。

主要采购单位为渠道、许可档位、AI容量及云资源。托管基础设施不意味着厂商会开发、部署或为客户应用项目打补丁；详细SaaS文档明确将这些项目工作留给实施团队。

core_features.explanation_en: Store content items and file assets in workspace-scoped folders for use across channels.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在按工作区划分的文件夹中存内容条目及文件资产，以跨渠道复用。

core_features.explanation_en: Buy web,email or headless channels withStandard/Advanced capabilities;microchannels have content-volume conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可购买网站、邮件或无头渠道，Standard/Advanced能力不同，微渠道有内容量条件。

core_features.explanation_en: SaaS provides infrastructure/portal services;project development/deployment/updates remain a customer responsibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: SaaS提供基础设施/门户服务，项目开发/部署/更新仍由客户负责。

pricing.summary_en: Quote combineschannelcount,Standard/Advancedtier,AIRAcredits andSaaScloudresources orprivate-cloud license.No numericcurrentrate,microchannelquota orAIunitcostverified.
pricing.summary_zh: 报价组合渠道数、Standard/Advanced档、AIRA积分及SaaS资源或私有云许可；未核实当前数字价、微渠道额度或AI单价。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Keep reusable items separate from channel pages
sections.title_zh: 区分复用条目与渠道页面
sections.en:
The business documentation distinguishes Content hub items, website pages and headless content. The hub stores reusable items and file assets, organized in folders and scoped to workspaces. An editor with access to several workspaces can switch them in the header. Its listing columns/order are saved in the editor’s local storage, so changing that view does not reconfigure every colleague’s interface.

For an illustrative product launch, model approved product copy and media in the hub, reuse it on a web page and expose the intended fields to an application channel. A developer must define the model, presentation and integration. Pilot shared-content updates and role permissions rather than assuming that reusing an item makes every destination correct or immediately refreshed.
sections.zh:
业务文档区分Content hub条目、网站页面及无头内容。中心存复用条目和文件资产，按文件夹组织、工作区划分；可访问多个工作区的编辑者能在页头切换。列表列项/顺序保存在该编辑者本地存储，调整视图不会重新配置所有同事界面。

例如产品发布，可在中心建获准产品文案及媒体，在网页复用，并向应用渠道暴露所需字段。开发者仍需定义模型、展示及集成。试点应验证共享内容更新和角色权限，不能假定复用条目会令所有目标自动正确或立即刷新。

sections.title_en: Count channels and choose the actual feature tier
sections.title_zh: 计算渠道并选择实际功能档位
sections.en:
The current purchase page says a platform license includes one main channel and further channels are purchased. Main types are web domains/subdomains,email marketing domains andGraphQLheadless channels. Microchannels are smaller presences limited by content volume, with thresholds depending on channel type. No public numeric channel price or microchannel quota was established; buying add-on channels up front is described as cheaper than later additions.

Standard targets basic single-channel use and does not allow additional main channels; the table excludes main email/headless and advanced marketing/AI features. Advanced supports multichannel expansion. Unlimited admin users or visitors does not mean unlimited licensed channels, email volume, storage or cloud resources. AIRA/Agentic Marketing Suite credits are another purchased capacity, and the actual plan must identify enabled capabilities and consumption rates.
sections.zh:
当前采购页称平台许可含一个主渠道，额外渠道另购；主类型为网站域名/子域名、邮件营销域及GraphQL无头渠道。微渠道面向较小内容规模，阈值随渠道类型而异。本次未建立公开渠道数字价或微渠道额度；页面称初次同时购附加渠道比后续追加便宜。

Standard面向基础单渠道，不能增加主渠道，表格排除主邮件/无头及高级营销/AI能力；Advanced支持多渠道扩展。管理员或访客无限，不代表许可渠道、邮件量、存储或云资源无限。AIRA/Agentic Marketing Suite积分为另一容量，实际方案需明确启用能力及消耗率。

sections.title_en: Keep an application owner even with SaaS
sections.en:
The deployment marketing page says Kentico handles hosting,pipelines,backups and security and describes ongoing refreshes. The detailed SaaS guide draws the important boundary: Kentico maintains infrastructure,Portal and deployment APIs, but does not develop/deploy the customer project or apply project hotfixes/refreshes on its behalf. The team must keep that project within supported releases; deployment of an unsupported version is not guaranteed.

Private cloud adds responsibility for provisioning,CI/CD,scaling,monitoring and rollback. The product uses modern.NET; exact runtime/database requirements were not inspected here. There is also an environment-count mismatch: marketing mentionsQA,UAT,STGandproduction,while itsFAQ says up to3environments. Obtain the selected service plan’s actual topology and capacity instead of assuming four included environments.
sections.zh:
部署营销页称Kentico负责主机、流水线、备份和安全，并描述持续refresh；详细SaaS指南划出重要边界：厂商维护基础设施、Portal及部署API，但不替客户开发/部署项目或应用项目hotfix/refresh。团队必须让项目保持受支持版本，未支持版本不能保证部署。

私有云另需负责资源、CI/CD、扩缩、监控及回滚。产品使用现代.NET，本次未检查确切运行/数据库要求。环境数量也不一致：营销列QA、UAT、STG及生产，FAQ却称最多3环境。应取得所选服务计划实际拓扑及容量，不能假定含四环境。

sections.title_en: Plan subscription dates and outbound license checks
sections.title_zh: 规划订阅日期及出站许可验证
sections.en:
Current licensing documentation describes a30-day evaluation license, production/nonproduction keys and subscription renewal. It says subscriptions expire at the start of the stated expiry date, with a30-day grace period included for paid private-cloud/Portal projects but not evaluations. Operational generated-key dates can differ from the purchased subscription date because keys synchronize automatically. Confirm the actual account dates rather than reading a short-lived key as the full subscription term.

Instances communicate daily with the vendor license server and require internet connectivity. After more than5days without contact, the administration displays notifications and logs. Use appropriate nonproduction keys when cloning a production database: the guide warns that a second production key can make channel usage look doubled. These are documented conditions, not tested expiration behavior or permission to bypass validation.
sections.zh:
当前许可文档描述30天评估、生产/非生产密钥及订阅续费，称订阅在标示到期日开始时过期；付费私有云/Portal项目日期含30天宽限期，评估版无宽限。密钥会自动同步，因此生成密钥的运行日期可能不同于已购订阅日期；需核对账户实际日期，不能将短期密钥当作完整订阅期限。

实例每天联系厂商许可服务器，要求互联网连接；超过5天无法联系时，后台显示通知并记录日志。复制生产数据库到非生产环境应使用相应密钥，指南提醒第二个生产密钥可能让渠道用量重复计数。上述是文档条件，未经到期实测，也不授权绕过验证。

sections.title_en: Check backup retention and management-plane locations
sections.title_zh: 检查备份保留及管理数据位置
sections.en:
The SaaS guide describes daily database/blob backups forproduction/staging,kept3–7days by service plan,and Sunday weekly backups retained30days;custom-environment policies depend on the custom plan. It describes on-demand full/partial backups and disaster recovery without establishing a contractual recovery-time or recovery-point guarantee here. Test a restore of the actual project,content and assets before relying on it.

Customer tenant data is placed in the chosen region,but the guide separately locatesPortal/Auth0and some pipeline/function logs inEurope. Selecting a tenant region therefore does not mean every category of management data stays there. Public availability/certification statements are vendor claims; no contract,trust-report audit or customer implementation compliance was verified.
sections.zh:
SaaS指南描述生产/暂存数据库及blob每日备份，按计划保留3–7天，周日周备份保留30天；定制环境依定制方案。文档描述按需完整/部分备份及灾难恢复，但本次未建立合同恢复时间或恢复点保证，依赖前应测试实际项目、内容及资产恢复。

客户租户数据位于所选区域，但指南另将Portal/Auth0及部分流水线/函数日志放在欧洲。因此选择租户区域不代表全部管理数据都留在那里。公开可用率/认证描述为厂商主张，本次未核实合同、信任报告审计或客户实现合规。

sections.title_en: Scope an upgrade rather than assume old and new products match
sections.title_zh: 明确升级范围，不能假定新旧产品等价
sections.en:
The current site positions Xperience by Kentico as the destination for migrations and distinguishes it fromKentico Xperience13. Its agreement index links currentSaaS/on-premises terms but also contains a long olderXperience13FAQ. Do not transfer that older edition’s website/source-code/renewal rules or example prices into a current quote. Full current agreement texts were not inspected, so exact redistribution/source rights remain unverified.

Kentico suits a team coordinating reusable content and several channels with an implementation partner or.NETcapability. A useful pilot covers one modeled item,channel page,editor role,headless endpoint if licensed,project patch/deployment and restoration. Migration tooling does not prove templates,custom code,URLs,permissions ormarketing history transfer unchanged. No installation,migration,publishing,licensing check,API,deployment orrestore was executed.
sections.zh:
当前官网将Xperience by Kentico作为迁移目标，并与Kentico Xperience13区分。协议索引链接当前SaaS/本地条款，但也包含很长的旧Xperience13 FAQ，不能将旧版网站/源码/续费规则或示例价搬进当前报价。本次未检查完整当前协议，因此再分发/源码权利仍未核实。

有实施伙伴或.NET能力、需协调复用内容及多渠道的团队可考虑。试点可覆盖一条建模内容、渠道页、编辑角色、许可允许时无头终端、项目补丁/部署和恢复。迁移工具不能证明模板、定制代码、URL、权限或营销历史原样迁移。本次未执行安装、迁移、发布、许可验证、API、部署或恢复。
